review_candidates.title: Deloitte Innovation Hub I Cyber Security I SecOps Detection Senior Engineer, Cairo. Egypt
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Connect to your opportunity Responsible for configuring, maintaining, and supporting CSOC platforms, tools and logging infrastructure ensuring all systems fully operational and secure. Design and develop security content for, SIEM, SOAR and EDR Configure and maintain SIEM, SOAR, EDR, and other CSOC platforms. Maintain a content repository with versioning, documentation, and lifecycle status. Maintain system documentation, configuration baselines, and maintenance records. 3–6 years of experience
eligibility_evidence: Egypt Your Work, Your Way: We call our hybrid working vision Deloitte Works.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: 3–6 years of experience in Cybersecurity Operations (CSOC), Detection Engineering, or Detection Content Development. Hands-on experience with the design and implementation of SIEM/SOAR platforms, such as Splunk, ELK, LogRhythm, Microsoft Sentinel, Palo Alto XSIAM, or similar. Solid knowledge of network infrastructure, Linux/Windows administration, and system monitoring, with expertise in security telemetry (firewall, EDR, proxy, and other log sources). Proficiency in query and scripting languages (e.g., KQL, SPL, Sigma) for automation, detection tuning, and source validation. Connect to your service line – Technology and Transformation Distinctive thinking, deep expertise, and collaborative working. Your expertise is our capability, so we’ll make sure it never stops growing.
